title: Employer On-Campus: Verkada
description: Meet Verkada engineers, learn how they’re using AI to build cutting-edge security products, and explore exciting internship and new grad opportunities with food and swag.

title: UBC AI Safety: Fall Launch Social
description: Mingle with students from all backgrounds, enjoy snacks, and dive into fun conversations about AI safety, upcoming programs, and how to get involved.

title: Coffee Chats with Verkada
description: Chat with engineers and recruiters about software roles, enjoy snacks and swag, and get insider tips on internships and new grad opportunities.

title: Student Sustainability FEST!
description: Explore sustainability projects, enjoy live music and free snacks, and join flash talks with a chance to win prizes and grab exclusive goodies.

title: Indigenous STEM Student Lunch Social
description: Enjoy a free lunch, connect with fellow Indigenous STEM students, and discover ways to get involved in the community.

title: PSA: Welcome Social
description: We present you, OUR FIRST EVENT of the year! This one is a bit different and more fun! On 25th September, at Kenny, 5PM-8PM, we will be playing board games, enjoying free snacks and slurping some delicious boba!

title: UBC CSA: External Ice Breaker
location: Great Hall South (second floor of the Nest)
description: Compete in team games, win prizes, and enjoy food, drinks, and fun activities while making new friends.

title: UBC VSA: Xin Chào 101
description: Join a night of icebreakers, games, food, and live performances while connecting with the VSA community and new friends.

title: UBC Anime Club: Ice Breaker
description: Compete in fun idol-themed games, train with exec “coaches,” win raffle prizes, and enjoy free pizza while meeting fellow club members.

title: UBC Game Dev: Launch Party
description: Hang out with fellow game developers, meet the team behind the club, and enjoy free pizza while learning how to get involved.

title: UBC SSA: Ice Breaker
description: Meet new friends, play games, win prizes, and enjoy plenty of good food at this fun annual icebreaker.

title: UBC UX Hub: Get to know us
description: Enjoy free food, meet fellow UX enthusiasts, and kickstart your journey with alumni, mentors, and peers in a fun, social setting.

title: WiCS x Atlassian: Women in Tech Panel
description: Join Atlassian as they launch into UBC 🚀 Enjoy a panel from Atlassian’s team followed by additional networking time to get to know the industry professionals. Get excited to learn about Atlassian (+ their career opportunities 👀), eat snacks, and connect with like-minded students!
